none: PAS NLM-9BFDED: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Nummus, possibly of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Mintmark would appear later than reverse; this reporter is unhappy with obverse reading. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: possibly [----]ANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLOR]IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: TRP . Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.45gms, die axis: 6
